ننتقي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِي (nantaqī) /nan.ta.qiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# نَنْتَقِيَ (nantaqiya) /nan.ta.qi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
